follow-up time: Third trimester and within 24 hours after delivery
finding: A novel extraction and analytical method for the assessment of 8-OHdG in urine was developed and validated, revealing that urinary 8-OHdG levels in pregnant women could predict oxidative stress in the placenta and were associated with maternal obesity, mode of delivery, and newborn sex.
mod_finding: Increased urinary non-adjusted 8-OHdG concentrations at the time of delivery were significantly associated with clinical records (any type of clinical record during pregnancy).
